item.title: Modest Mouse Replaces Guitarist Simon O’Connor Amid Allegations
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our show, I'm your host. Today, we're talking about some unexpected news from the music world. Modest Mouse has announced that guitarist Simon O'Connor will not be joining their upcoming North American tour. This comes after allegations surfaced that O'Connor sent inappropriate social media messages to a minor.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "The band made the announcement on Instagram, stating that O'Connor will be replaced by Les Savy Fav guitarist Seth Jabour. In their post, Modest Mouse wrote, 'Simon O'Connor will not be joining us on the upcoming tour. The good news is that Seth Jabour of Les Savy Fav will be jumping in to play guitar. We look forward to being out there with you all.'
[Short pause]
Host: "The allegations against O'Connor surfaced in late July, when a Reddit user claimed that the guitarist sent them an explicit image and commented on their photos. O'Connor responded to the allegations, stating that he 'unequivocally' opposes any sexual behavior towards minors. He claimed that he mistook the Reddit user for someone who had been trolling him online and made a mistake by sending the messages.
[Soft music continues to play]
Host: "Modest Mouse is set to embark on their North American tour on August 4th, in support of their latest album, 'An Eraser and a Maze'. The tour will wrap up on October 24th in Sacramento. We'll be keeping an eye on this story and bringing you updates as more information becomes available.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our show. We'll be back with more news and updates from the music world. Until next time, goodbye!"
